name: Healthper
summary: Healthper runs more than 200 team and individual wellness challenges, along with health assessments, health coaching and a health library, and reports participation, utilization and risk. The vendor publishes no price on its site, and its program buttons link to Microsoft AppSource.

facts.text: The homepage says the platform offers over 200 team and individual challenges, which can be customized.
The homepage lists a 12-week miles tracking team challenge, a 12-week mental well-being challenge and a 12-week heart challenge.
The homepage lists a comprehensive health assessment, digital and live health coaching, and a health library with over 300 activities and educational content.
The homepage says the platform provides in-depth participation, utilization and risk reporting and analytics, and a centralized dashboard to measure program performance.
The homepage shows no prices. Program buy buttons link to Microsoft AppSource, which was not read for this profile.
